definitions.gloss: cooperativeness; spirit of harmony; ability to work with others
definitions.explanation: The quality of being willing and able to cooperate with others, work as part of a team, and maintain harmony in a group. Highly valued in Japanese society and workplaces.

examples.japanese: {協調性|きょうちょうせい}がある{人|ひと}。
{協調性|きょうちょうせい}は{就職|しゅうしょく}{活動|かつどう}でよくアピールされる。
examples.english: Cooperativeness is often emphasized during job hunting.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{能力|のうりょく}は{高|たか}いが、{協調性|きょうちょうせい}に{欠|か}けるところがある。
examples.english: He is highly capable, but somewhat lacking in cooperativeness.

notes:
Compound noun: {協調|きょうちょう} (cooperation, harmony) + {性|せい} (nature, disposition). A key concept in Japanese workplace culture, where ability to work harmoniously with others is considered as important as individual skills.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {協調性|きょうちょうせい}がある (to be cooperative)
- {協調性|きょうちょうせい}に{欠|か}ける (to lack cooperativeness)
- {協調性|きょうちょうせい}を{養|やしな}う (to cultivate cooperativeness)
